effect_text: Whether SnapKV compression runs depends on `self.kv_seq_len` cached from earlier calls: on the first (prefill) call the KV is compressed and `self.kv_seq_len` registered; on later calls the else-branch just appends to the cache. So the same input produces different KV contents depending on call history, and the sparse pattern is then computed over the compressed KV.
